text:
Alex Chen: Quick ping — can someone take a look at this infra PR when you have a sec? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/782. Small Terraform change: route table assoc + NATGW route for us-east-1b. Need to merge today for the canary rollout.
Priya Singh: passing by — what exactly is being changed? any risk to prod subnets?
Alex Chen: TL;DR: new private subnet in us-east-1b needs a route to our existing NATGW. No SG/ACL changes. Plan snippet below.
Alex Chen: ```
  # module.vpc.aws_route.nat_route will be created
  + resource "aws_route" "nat_route" {
      + cidr_block                = "0.0.0.0/0"
      + gateway_id                = (known after apply)
      + instance_id               = (known after apply)
      + nat_gateway_id            = "nat-0a1b2c3d4e5f"
      + route_table_id            = "rtb-0abc1234def"
    }

Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
```
Samir Patel: I can review in ~30m. Did you run terraform fmt & validate? last time an apply hit the policy-scan for missing tags.
Alex Chen: ran fmt/validate locally. Pushed a tag map in variables. Also ran a dry plan with the policy scanner — it flagged a missing "billing:owner" tag on the nat gateway resource; added that in the last commit.
DeployBot: ci/terraform-plan — running checks...
DeployBot: ci/terraform-plan — policy-scan failed (missing required tags on module.vpc.aws_nat_gateway). See: https://ci.redwood/in/job/782/3
Priya Singh: hmm, did the new commit get picked up by CI? sometimes webhooks lag.
Alex Chen: pushed a force re-run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/782/checks
Jin Park: I'm oncall today so can't approve infra PRs, but can eyeball for obvious issues. Do we need a downtime window? if it's just route table assoc for private subnet, no.
Maria Rodriguez: I'll take this one. looking at the plan now.
Maria Rodriguez: quick nit: nat gateway resource needs the tag keys to match our org-policy: "team", "billing:owner", "environment". Also add a lifecycle ignore for allocation_id drift? better to avoid churn.
Alex Chen: thanks — added tags & lifecycle ignore in the last commit and pushed.
DeployBot: ci/terraform-plan — all checks passed ✅
Samir Patel: reviewed — left one comment about using data.aws_nat_gateway instead of hardcoding id, but that's optional for this rollout. No blockers from my side.
Maria Rodriguez: LGTM after the tiny comment is addressed or acknowledged. Approving the PR now.
Maria Rodriguez: @Alex Chen — please squash the fixup commit and then you can merge once CI green. I'll add the required approver check so it can go in today.
Alex Chen: Will squash & merge when CI is green. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: thanks for the quick turnaround.
InfraBot: PR merged by Alex Chen at 1799130200 — apply started for workspace "prod-us-east-1".
Alex Chen: apply finished cleanly. Canaries are running — monitoring for 15m then promote. Leaving a note in the rollout doc.
Samir Patel: cheers — ping if anything odd shows up.
Jin Park: nice, thanks all!
